title: BERM canonical observation
description: One row of any BERM canonical data product. The authoritative implementation is berm/berm/data/contracts.py; this document is the language-neutral statement of the same contract, for consumers outside Python. Where the two disagree, contracts.py wins and this file is the bug.

source_url.description: Retrieval URL, a doi: reference, or the literal ACCESS_REQUIRED.

license.description: Licence or terms of use under which the value may be redistributed.

retrieved_at.description: Date the value was pulled from the source. Must not be in the future.

source_period.description: Period the source itself reports, e.g. 2019 or 2018/2019. The year field must fall inside it.

geography_id.description: ISO-3166 alpha-3 at COUNTRY level, ISO-3166-2 style (GBR-SCT) at SUBNATIONAL1/METRO, a registered supranational code, or WLD at GLOBAL.

sex.description: NA is rejected in tables declared sex-stratified.

age_group.description: ALL and NA are rejected in tables declared age-stratified.

birth_cohort.description: Year of birth. Must not be later than the observation year.

unit.description: Must appear in the unit vocabulary of the containing table, declared in contracts.CANONICAL_TABLES.

measurement_type.description: OBSERVED is a measurement of the quantity itself. PROXY is a measurement of something else standing in for it. SCENARIO_PARAMETER is an assumption. DERIVED is computed from other canonical rows. These must never be merged or displayed without their label.

proxy_flag.description: Must be true when measurement_type is PROXY and false when it is OBSERVED.

imputation_flag.description: True when the value was filled rather than reported. Requires transform_pipeline_version to record how.

uncertainty_lower.description: Must be given together with uncertainty_upper, and must bracket value.

transform_pipeline_version.description: Name and semantic version of the pipeline that produced the row, e.g. wb_ingest@v1.0.0.

then.description: An assumption without an explicit range cannot be varied, tested, or falsified.
